name: VERT
description: VERT is a file converter that runs in the browser. Images, audio and documents are converted locally with WebAssembly, so files never leave the device; videos the browser cannot handle can be sent to a vertd server.

notes.text: Open https://<IP> and accept the self-signed certificate; the converters only work over HTTPS.
Videos the browser cannot convert go to VERT's public vertd servers by default. Set your own vertd instance in the settings to keep them local.
